component.name: Luma SDK
component.summary: Compilers, headers and tools for building Luma applications

description.p: The Luma SDK is the development runtime matching the Luma Platform. It is built from the same Fedora 44 packages as the Luma operating system, including Luma's GTK 4, libadwaita, the Luma Developer Platform, the Prairie icon theme and Luma's fonts, so an application looks and behaves the same on Luma and on any other distribution with Flatpak.
